verdict: Leads surged this week, but heating season prep is overdue.
narrative: This period delivered 18 tracked leads at an average cost of $91.55 per lead, with the sharpest activity concentrated in just three days — October 1–3 — when 13 leads arrived. That efficiency jump is real and driven by increased ad spend, particularly on Google, which scaled up significantly week-over-week. However, several agreed milestones are past due, including heating campaign launches on both Google and Meta and the re-enabling of Local Services Ads, which means you're entering the heating season without heating-specific spend in market. Getting those campaigns live is the immediate priority so the momentum from this week carries into your highest-demand months.

watch_item.issue: Heating campaigns and Local Services Ads are not yet live, despite the heating season having started — you currently have no heating-specific spend in market.
watch_item.fix: Launching the overdue heating campaigns on Google and Meta and re-enabling Local Services Ads are the active priority this week.
